Changes.note: “Save” writes the course’s name, introduction, weeks and sessions at once, as the form holds them. A week or session you take out of the form is not deleted: it is hidden at your level and brought back from the course’s archive; files taken out are also removed from storage. If the course is published, the change shows on the page talebe see at once, and enrolled talebe whose session changes or is hidden are e-mailed a calendar update or cancellation. If someone saved the course while you were editing, nothing is written.
